name: Ring of Evasion
description: A plain band of quicksilver that will not sit still on the finger.
body:
## What it does

It holds three charges and regains 1d3 each dawn. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can spend one as a reaction to succeed instead.

features.name: Evasion
features.text: As a reaction, spend a charge to turn a failed Dexterity save into a success.
